title: 4.6 Analyzing Lines of Fit

icans: I can use residuals to tell whether a line fits data well.
I can use technology to find a line of best fit and the correlation coefficient.
I can tell the difference between correlation and causation.

vocab: the _____________ between an actual y-value and the y-value predicted by the model (actual − predicted)
a __________ plot of the residuals; a good fit has residuals scattered randomly around 0
a number from −1 to 1 that tells how __________ the data fit a line
a change in one ___________ causes a change in another
